claim: The founder interviews establish that small studios will pay for a decision-handoff integration.

evidence.quote: I lose the supplier decision every time somebody hands the project over.
A new project owner spent Monday reconstructing why we picked that vendor.
Our existing issue template already handles most handoffs.

rationale: Two operators describe a retrieval problem. A third already has a partial substitute. None of the three discusses price, a purchase or an integration requirement. The available evidence supports a manual pilot to learn whether the handoff helps.
caveats: These are synthetic interviews. The verdict concerns what the fixture establishes.
High confidence refers to the evidentiary gap. Actual willingness to pay remains unknown.
